actual: MA-E23 preflight proved CustomEvoLoopConfig.sector_blacklist is persisted and displayed, but config_composer classifies it as non-strategy metadata and no QE execution path materializes the blacklist into the run-scoped PIT stock pool. P01/P11 therefore execute identically to P00 while UI may report blacklist enabled. Preserve frozen direct-v2/PIT data-plane rules, apply the submitted blacklist to the run-scoped executable universe before prediction/backtest, keep P00 byte-equivalent, fail closed on missing PIT industry mapping, and report requested/effective/excluded counts without database fallback.
closure_requirements: Keep BUG JSON and GitHub Issue synchronized.
